title: SurvivalK
description: SurvivalK is a mod which adds things to help you survive, and thrive.
body:
# Need a super high performance and easy Minecraft server at a good price? Try [godlike.host](https://godlike.host/?aff_id=1323) now!
![GodLike.Host](https://godlike.host/wp-content/uploads/2023/06/godlike_logo_horizontal_join_ua_v1.png)

![Banner](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a4a2ff6004676a6be63ec6176a5716116bc8803f.png)

This is a mod that adds more stuff to improve survival and help you thrive also may be a bit unbalanced. it curently adds the following.

-Silkbell Plant\
-A two part Parka\
-Cooked Silkbells\
-Cloth\
-Trimmed Silkbells

And many more to come. 

**_Its curently only for Forge 1.20.1!!!_**
